item.title: BlueWallet v8.0.1
item.description:
BlueWallet 8.0.1 | BlueWallet_8.0.1_1784575843
### New Features
iOS 26 Liquid Glass design Import Unchained JSON as a multisig cosigner Support BC-UR v2 air-gap scanning for hardware wallets (OneKey, Keystone) Option to redact push notification content Arkade Lightning push notifications Enable RBF for single-sig watch-only wallets (HD Bech32) Human-readable data on transaction status screen 19 new languages, including Filipino, Armenian, Akan, and Sesotho
### Improvements
Renewed Settings UI Better green success color contrast Removed GroundControl server URL option from notification settings Faster transaction fetching for HD wallets Replaced crypto-js with modern @noble crypto libraries
### Fixes
Startup crash Amount input lag in RBF custom fee input Text size on main app views and clipped wallet balance in carousel QR codes no longer have rounded corners Signed transaction hex screen stays scrollable Arkade LNURL payment result now persists Floating button no longer overlaps the transaction list Various modal and navigation UX polish
Under the hood: dependency updates, TypeScript coverage improvements, CI and translation tooling fixes.
